review_method: Hash the exact expected configuration, historical snapshot, fresh snapshot, snapshot report, and checked-in provenance documents independently.

Decode the expected configuration with jq and inventory every serialized runtime or designator commitment, complete profile, scalar coherence field, semantic field, smart-account pair, and intentionally null discovery field.
Compare the reviewed_at boundary with the retained historical fixed-boundary snapshot and compare all 42 serialized non-null runtime/designator commitments with the fresh 41-address startup snapshot.

Inspect the strict startup validators for document-role separation, exact production profile equality, required profile completeness, address-plus-implementation matching, code length, runtime hash, mutable Hood configuration, and smart-account factory/delegation pair completeness.
Inspect protocol proof and negative tests for Pons, Clanker, Bankr/Doppler, and Hood semantic profiles rather than treating the fresh observation as the source of expected values.
Diff the expected configuration, source tree, and scripts against repository parent 74c1062 and require no changes in this attestation batch.

commitment_coverage.note: The serialized commitment count includes deliberate duplicate/coherence commitments such as the Hood scalar factory hash and profile identity, the Bankr Airlock profile and call pin, and dependencies shared across protocols.

evidence: PaperExpectedPins denies unknown fields and requires schema 4 expected_protocol_pins with reviewed_protocol_pins provenance.
Strict startup accepts reviewed expected pins only with a distinct startup_observation document and nonzero historical and fresh boundaries.
LeaveHood factory/core, Klik, and Trench runtime fields remain null and therefore confer no authority.
The fixed-boundary and fresh snapshots contain the exact Bow factory runtime commitment required by strict startup.
The explorer source remains unverified; this attests a code commitment, not source reproducibility.
Strict startup compares the factory runtime and the implementation address, byte length, and runtime hash with separate observed pins.
The checked-in review ties the ABI/source and both fixed-block commitments to LaunchHood V3.
ConfiguredClankerV4 constructs the exact production factory, deployer, PoolManager, hook, locker, MEV module, and extension profile.
Validation requires equality with ClankerV4ExpectedProfile::production, including fee bounds, decay, guard, and protocol share; partial production configuration rejects startup.

The exact production profile covers Airlock, PoolManager, initializer, Rehype hook, token factory/implementation, governance factory, and migrator plus exact fee, duration, tick, allocation, curve, beneficiary, and delay values.
The sole call pin is exact Airlock plus selector 0x882db707.

The account profile is exact EntryPoint v0.7 plus EIP-7702 account designator and delegated Kernel runtime; factory and factory runtime are both null, while the required delegation address/runtime pair is complete.

Fresh report proof transaction 0xc6597fe88f3f16b4ba6613c25050d75dc6f3c2b2c5315f0b47828f98f0609c matches selector 0xe9ae5c53, all-zero mode, Airlock, selector 0x882db707, designator, implementation, and runtime commitments.
Configured Pons V3 must contain each of the seven exact production identities once with exact address, byte length, and runtime hash.
The EIP-7702 profile must equal Eip7702SelfBatchExpectedPins::production; fresh startup separately requires the 23-byte designator at the account and nonempty exact implementation runtime.
The retained Pons provenance document binds the proof transaction, block/hash, L1 block, timestamp, index, authorization nonce, implementation deployment transaction, and delegation pair.

HoodExpectedProfile validation requires exact equality with production, ten unique nonzero role/address/byte/hash identities, and exact curve, fee, migration, tick, owner, Safe, V3, and guard semantics.

Strict startup requires scalar factory/profile coherence, every observed identity including the Safe proxy/singleton pair, and a fixed-block Hood protocol snapshot matching callable links and mutable configuration.
Migration identity evidence does not attest migrated-market quote readiness or execution safety.

checks: The expected and fresh documents have different roles, provenances, boundaries, SHA-256 hashes, and Keccak-256 hashes.
The expected reviewed_at L2 block 10980306 predates the fresh observed_at L2 block 11986583.
The expected configuration SHA-256 equals the value recorded before the fresh snapshot comparison and is unchanged at repository parent 74c1062.
The snapshot tool writes only a new observed_startup_snapshot and refuses to overwrite existing or hard-linked evidence paths.
Strict startup rejects an expected document used as an observed snapshot and rejects same-path expected/observed inputs in the reconciler and runner.
This attestation changes no expected pin, source, or script file.

limitations: This is a docs/source/artifact review. It does not repeat public RPC calls and therefore relies on content-addressed retained fixed-boundary and fresh-snapshot artifacts.

The historical 39-pin snapshot predates the separately reviewed two-pin Pons EIP-7702 profile; that profile is substantiated by its exact proof provenance, strict production equality, negative tests, and the later 41-pin fresh snapshot.
Bow and the current Pons factory have documented source-verification gaps; this attests fixed-block runtime identity, not reproducible source builds.
Flap and Permit2 have no configurable expected-pin fields in schema 4. Their source constants are outside this configuration attestation.
A single fresh boundary cannot prove continuous runtime stability or future safety.
This attestation does not validate quote accuracy, feed coverage, wallet safety, signing, broadcasting, deployment, canary readiness, or execution readiness.
